# Event catalogue

Every topic registered with `defineTopic()` in `@paperos/core/events`. The envelope, the
transactional outbox and the delivery rules are [ADR 0013](../adr/0013-domain-events-outbox.md);
the shapes are Interface & Data Contracts section 3.

44 topics. Producers marked **placeholder** are registered here so consumers can
subscribe today; the owning issue flips the status to `live` in the commit that starts
publishing.

## Rules a subscriber can rely on

* Delivery is **at-least-once**, so every handler is idempotent on `event.id` and says so
  (`on(topic, handler, { name, idempotent: true })`).
* Ordering is guaranteed **per `subject`** only, never across subjects.
* `occurredAt` is the database `now()` at insert, never a process clock.
* Payloads carry **ids and changed fields only** — no rows, no names, no contact details. The
  PII denylist (`packages/core/src/events/pii.json`) is enforced when the topic is registered
  and again when an event is published; payloads over 64 KB are rejected.
* A breaking payload change bumps `version`; the previous reader lives 30 days.
